heroHeadline: AI Co-Clinician Matches Physicians in DeepMind Study; Flood Hub Reaches 700M+ People Across 150 Countries as AI for Good Accelerates Globally
heroSubtitle: Google DeepMind published AI co-clinician research showing the system matched or outperformed primary care physicians in 68 of 140 clinical areas with zero critical errors in 97 of 98 realistic queries — directly targeting the WHO-projected 10M health worker shortfall. Google Flood Hub expanded to 150 countries and 700M+ people via Gemini-powered 'Groundsource' flash flood forecasting. Eli Lilly opened the 'LillyPod' AI supercomputer (1,016 NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs) as the AI drug discovery market hit $1.13B. Apple's 2026 Swift Student Challenge — themed 'AI meets accessibility' — showcased 350 developers from 37 countries building real disability access tools, while the EU Council published an AI literacy framework for 27 member states covering 80M+ students.
footerNote: Data sourced from peer-reviewed journals (Nature, Science, The Lancet, npj Digital Medicine, Gut, Frontiers in Education), UN agencies (WHO, FAO, WFP, UNESCO, ITU), and major technology research outlets. Impact claims require independent validation; contested figures are marked.
